plan.claim: A large share of arrival delay minutes was inherited from the aircraft's previous leg rather than born on the leg, larger than the reported late aircraft field says.
plan.estimator: Rotations from tail numbers with the integrity rules; departure delay on the previous arrival's excess over the scheduled turn less a minimum turn, with carrier by date, origin by date and departure hour fixed effects; the buffer curve by scheduled turnaround bin.
plan.interval: Cluster robust by tail number and day for the coefficient.
plan.simulator: Coefficient bias and coverage, inherited share error (recovery study).
plan.split: choose on 2015 to 2022, report on 2023 to the latest month; the minimum turn is chosen by profile on the fitting years and held fixed.
plan.test: The coefficient and the inherited share with intervals; the halving buffer.
plan.title: Most delay is inherited
